question: Will criminal or civil immigration charges be brought against Ilhan Omar before 2027?

calls.reasoning: Base rate: high-profile federal probes of sitting members with search warrants usually take months to a year+ to produce charges; only ~6.5 weeks remain. This administration's DOJ has charged political targets fast (Comey, James, McIver), the grand jury is active, phone seized Oct 2026, and civil denaturalization (no SOL) would count. But the government told the court the warrant hasn't been fully executed and charges would follow only after that; the 5-year limitations period blocks most 2000-2009 conduct; the bodyguard cooperator case was dropped then re-indicted, suggesting a case still being built; holiday period. Polymarket 'federally charged by Dec 31' is ~22% (~$182k volume; figure from harness, page fetch failed). It covers criminal only, while this question also counts civil and state actions.

calls.dossier:
- Oct 12/14, 2026: HSI/FBI executed a search warrant at Omar's D.C. home; phone seized (NBC News, AP via PBS). The sealed warrant reportedly cites conspiracy, false statements, and immigration fraud.
- About a dozen grand jury subpoenas went out, including to relatives; Omar herself was not subpoenaed (NBC, Oct 2026). Grand jury reported in Minnesota (NBC) and in D.C. (NYT via GV Wire, Nov 11); probe run by HSI, DOJ, and the Minneapolis USAO.
- Allegations under review: 2009 marriage to Ahmed Elmi (sham marriage, possibly her brother); whether she was 18 rather than 17 at her father's 2000 naturalization (birth-year discrepancy); finances; House financial disclosures (PJ Media Nov 12; WaPo Oct 13).
- The Minnesota USAO investigated during Trump's first term and closed without charges because the statute of limitations had run (Star Tribune). The usual criminal SOL is 5 years (10 for naturalization fraud under 18 USC 1425, which was from 2000). Civil denaturalization (8 USC 1451) has no SOL, would be a DOJ civil complaint in federal court, and counts for this question. Homan and DHS Sec. Mullin have publicly raised denaturalization ('no expiration').
- In recent filings, government attorneys said the search warrant has not yet been fully executed and any charges would come after that is complete (news summary, Nov 2026).
- Ex-bodyguard Abdullahi Mohamed: indicted April 2026 for green-card lies; dropped Sept 4, a day after his Sept 3 grand jury testimony; indicted again ~Nov 11 for lying under oath. Former prosecutors question the case's merit (GV Wire/NYT, Nov 11).
- Omar won re-election Nov 3, 2026 and calls the probe political retaliation (MPR).
- Nov 17, 2026 hearing in D.C. federal court on unsealing the warrant records; 14 press organizations are seeking release (Judicial Watch).
- Rep. Nancy Mace moved to subpoena immigration records; Comer is probing finances; FEC complaints filed (separate from charges; these don't count).
- Status quo: no charge or civil action filed as of Nov 16, 2026.
- Resolution: resolves on a publicly filed criminal charge OR civil enforcement action about immigration/citizenship, by any US government authority in federal or state court. A sealed indictment that isn't public would not count; congressional or ethics actions don't count.
- Event window: now -> Dec 31, 2026 per the criteria; as of Nov 16, 2026 about 6.5 weeks remain (the question opened Nov 9; the probe has been public since ~Sept/Oct 2026).
- Searched but not found: any reported timeline for an indictment, a target letter, DOJ leadership sign-off, or a filed denaturalization complaint.

calls.dossier:
- Status as of 2026-11-16 (multiple outlets incl. MPR 2026-11-03, Star Tribune, RedState 2026-11-12): Omar has NOT been charged criminally, and no civil denaturalization suit has been filed.
- Oct 2026: DHS/HSI agents executed a sealed search warrant at Omar's DC-area home and seized her phone. Per a source (Star Tribune), the warrant lists conspiracy, false statements on immigration paperwork and immigration fraud as potential crimes. Border czar Homan confirmed an immigration investigation.
- More than a dozen grand-jury subpoenas went to relatives, including sister Sahra Noor (Minnesota federal grand jury per reports). Her ex-bodyguard Abdullahi Mohamed testified before a Washington grand jury on 2026-09-03.
- Mohamed was indicted in April 2026 for lying under oath. Prosecutors moved to dismiss on 2026-09-04, the day after his grand jury testimony. NYT reported his case 2026-11-11. His lawyer Bruce Rivers says prosecutors called the probe '100 percent being run by 1600 Pennsylvania Ave.' and offered deportation protection for damaging information about Omar (Struggle-La Lucha, 2026-11-15, citing NYT).
- Earlier inquiry (2016-2019 era, US Attorney Erica MacDonald, per Western Journal/Star Tribune): reportedly concluded Omar likely took part in fraud but brought no charges because the statute of limitations had passed. The Minnesota USAO is not participating in the current probe.
- Rep. Tom Emmer told Newsmax on 2026-11-12 that DOJ is 'finalizing' a review of Omar's birth date and examining 'four different things'. He gave no timeline.
- Civil denaturalization (8 USC 1451) has no statute of limitations and must be filed in federal court. DOJ is running its 'largest denaturalization effort in department history' (batch of 40 cases announced 2026). The whatthefact fact check (2026-11-10) says no proceedings have been started against Omar.
- Omar was reelected 2026-11-03 with about 76%. She denies wrongdoing and calls the probe political persecution.
- Context: the Trump DOJ in 2025 moved quickly to indict political adversaries (e.g., Comey, Letitia James), but those cases faced legal setbacks.
- Resolution: resolves off any criminal charge OR civil enforcement action relating to her immigration/citizenship, publicly filed by a US government authority in federal or state court. Sealed indictments don't count until public. Administrative actions outside court don't count.
- Event window: now -> 2026-12-31 per the criteria; the question opened 2026-11-09, and as of 2026-11-16 about 45 days remain.
- Searched but not found: any report of an imminent indictment date, any DOJ court filing naming Omar, a Polymarket rules page or price history (fetch failed).

calls.reconciliation: Runs agreed on nearly all facts: no filing as of Nov 16; sealed warrant citing conspiracy/false statements/immigration fraud; DOJ said charges follow complete warrant execution; Polymarket criminal-only ~22%. Minor factual disputes (grand jury venue MN vs DC; whether MN USAO participates) cannot be settled without web access, and neither changes much: either venue can return a charge, and DC USAO (Pirro) appears to lead. The main judgment is how much civil-denaturalization scope adds over the criminal-only market, versus the market's likely YES skew and the short window. I treat these as roughly cancelling and land slightly below market, at 0.19.
